claims.text: The scenario: 1.2 atm of N2 and O2 at the water level, seas and lakes over 28% of the surface, shield-filtered sunlight, g 1.62 m/s2, a 29.53-day solar day
The lunar column holds 7.25 times Earth's air per square metre (74,861 against 10,332 kg/m2)
Scale height about 52 km against a 1,737 km radius, H/R about 23 times Earth's; horizon air mass from 35 to about 7
One Earth day after sunset the Sun stands 12.2 deg down, the shadow 40.1 km up, with 0.465 of an isothermal column's mass above it
121,590 Pa at the water level; O2 21,227 Pa (17.5%); Earth's Ar/N2; 400 ppm CO2; global mean 1.16 atm, 1.03-1.22 atm
Seas at 28% of the surface; with rain-fed lakes 40% of the GCM's cells are water
TSIS-1 through the titania shield: 1,235 W/m2 at the top of the air, dimmed to 1,198 W/m2 (scale 0.970) in the design case; no ozone behind the shield
Column water vapour 170 kg/m2 in the design case and 348 kg/m2 in the longwave-and-ice test (years 15-19 of each); Earth about 25
Mass-mean height 48.6 km; a shell 50 km up has 5.8% more area; horizon air mass 7.1 for air and 13.5 for water against PlaSim's 35
Gravity at the 86 km tropopause 9% below the surface's; a constant-area column with falling gravity holds about 6% more air than p_s/g_s
Pressure levels six times higher; droplets 6.04x, rain 2.94x, graupel 2.27x slower; sea roughness 6.04x longer; deep-water waves 0.41 of Earth's speed
Lunar convection is Earth's stretched about sixfold in size and duration; 6 km columns resolve deep storms as 1 km columns do on Earth
Soil thermal wave about 0.6 m deep, 5.4 times Earth's diurnal depth; Coriolis 5.2e-6 /s at 80 deg, inertial period 14 days
CM1 sets g = 9.81 in constants.F, module_ra_etc.F, getcape.F and morrison.F; Morrison's fall-speed laws and caps hold Earth's gravity
WRF-ELEC's NSSL sets gr = 9.8 twice and ties rain and ice ventilation to Earth's fall-speed coefficients
Breakdown cap 180 kV/m acts below ~4.5 km on Earth and ~36 km in lunar air (-44% at the ground); -7 C ground-strike level 5 km on Earth, 27-34 km on the Moon; 0.75 s sub-step for 500 m layers
SWAN's AGROW knee fixed at 1 Hz, called largely arbitrary in its comments; stock SWAN misses the sixfold similarity test by 5.44% in Hs
SWAN fixes air density at 1.28 kg/m3; CM1's air over the equatorial seas averages 1.40390 kg/m3
RRTMG sets CO2 by calendar year and carries Earth's CH4, N2O, halocarbons and ozone; CM1's beta plane uses Earth's rotation and a 6,370 km radius
Slingo's convective cover converts rain with the model's solar day (29.8 Earth days for the Moon): rain read 30x too heavy, cover +0.42; bias 0.125 ln(day)
ExoPlaSim's 360-day year of 17,280 steps holds 12.08 lunar model days of 1,430 steps; output slips 120 steps a year
CM1's Sun follows Earth's day, calendar and a 23.5 deg obliquity (radconst); soil layers 1-16 cm; the lunar thermal wave about 0.6 m
WRF-ELEC's conduction is off by default; in a month-long lunar run ion charge persisted for weeks, holding ~20 kV/m at the ground
The curved geometry takes in 10.3 W/m2 more sunlight, lets out 16.2 W/m2 more infrared, 5.8 W/m2 net, nearly all from the shells' widening; twilight 1.4 W/m2 on the ground
PlaSim's horizon magnification 35/sqrt(1 + 1224 mu^2); the Moon's factor 13.5 for water and 7.1 for air
PlaSim's thin shell and CM1's flat slab hold g constant; reference models use GM/r^2; g 5.4% lower at 48.6 km and 15.3% at 150 km
Lacis-Hansen water absorptivity left the air absorbing 7.7-8.2 points too little on 11 columns
Rayleigh normalised to a 5772 K blackbody gives too low a coefficient for the filtered Sun; TH2OC over-absorbs; uncalibrated design case passed 310 K, 315.5 K at year 12
PlaSim's two shortwave bands omit CO2 and O2, whose sunlight went to the water vapour lower down
Sasamori longwave cools the lowest two layers 9.7-11.9 W/m2 too much and the air aloft up to 12 W/m2 too little against correlated-k
CCM3 cloud water falls off on 700 ln(1+PW) m of geometric height; lunar cloud above ~20 km left nearly dry
Liquid optics for all cloud; saturation over liquid; high cloud at 180-204 K forms at 136-149% of ice saturation
RRTMG reference pressures begin at 1,053.63 hPa; the lowest 7.4-7.5 km over the sea are extrapolated in ln p; ice optics end at 140 um; the box stopped at day 6.45 at 157 um
Morrison bounds rain's mean diameter at 2.8 mm (LAMMINR) and begins breakup above 0.3 mm (brkup_db default); the capillary length is 2.46x longer at lunar g
Retained Earth calibrations: Wu drag, Komen, the AGROW coefficient, breaker index 0.73, SWASH breaking 0.6/0.3, the charging laws (Takahashi's inverts the lunar storms' polarity)
solang turns the Sun at the rotation rate and restarts each model day: skip 32.5 deg a day on the Moon, ~1 deg on Earth; equator -8.3% at 270-57 E, +17% near 164 E
The fixedorbit default puts Earth's orbit for 1 AD (23.695 deg) in place of the configured one: 149 against 29 W/m2 at 86 deg; summer rain to 60 deg
SWAN reads KTETA uninitialised with breaking off; repeated Earth runs differed ~2.5% in Hs; hidden with breaking on
CM1 on several threads parts at 3,000-7,400 s, first in total vertical momentum, in the plain Morrison box too; unlocated
PlaSim's lowest level reads up to ~20 K too cold in 0.8% of 3-day windows, most likely from the spectral transform over steep terrain
The runner's held infrared tail put 86% of sunlight in the near infrared and warmed the first run past 320 K

First electrified build: field a median 3.2x breakdown at discharge, 150 C removed; uninitialised scaling and a privatised variable caught by thread-count changes; ventilation missed, rain evaporating 1.3-1.5x too fast
The ledger's first channels absorbed 104.5 W/m2 above 500 nm against the fine grid's 66.2, 58% too much
Terrain forcing by a corner column at 2.9 km; constant vapour above the GCM's 130 km top, 6-15x ice-saturated at 140-150 km; the 45 N twilight pair on -O2 and -O3 builds
The first box rained in the mornings and was stopped at day 47; at 45 N the missing sideways transport is about a third of CM1's warm offset
